correctness.rationale: For every D,E>=1 over F_2, Frobenius gives T^(2^r)-I multiplication by u^a+v^a+u^av^a on F_2[u,v]/(u^D,v^E), a=2^(r+1). Splitting by exponents mod a produces truncated chain pairs. The automorphism Y->(1+X)Y sends X+Y to X+Y+XY, and the quotient by X+Y has length min(d_i,e_j). Summing chain survival indicators gives exactly K_r and #Fix=2^K_r. Distinct monomials show exact operator order 2^R, and nested fixed-point counts yield least periods, cycle counts and zeta. For dyadic windows with max>=4, K_(R-1)=DE/2 proves full-period proportion 1-2^(-DE/2). Reviewed actual RESULT.md and artifacts/verify_corner.py at pinned tree; independent constructed bitwise operator and 405 exact rank checks, including K(5,7)=(10,19,35). One-sided D=1 or E=1 handled by vanishing truncated shifts. No assumption that short finite checks establish the universal formula.
